source:
@@U01724@@
“Chacun a son gout!” | cried,
raising my glass.
“Show me a girl to match my 格蕾琴!
Show me a better sister!”
We all clinked glasses at that.
And the braggarts sat there like bumps on a log.
But they scorn me now,
sneer at me,
call me names!
I sit there ashamed, taking it all,
and I| can’t call one of them a liar!
Who's that coming?
Two of them, slinking toward her door.
If that’s the bastard, I'll kill him!
Vl kill him!

@@U01725@@
(Enter 浮士德 and 梅菲斯特.)

@@U01727@@
I see the sanctuary lamp in the sacristy,
its gleam shoots upwards, then, fainter and fainter,
fades away, swallowed by darkness and gloom,
the same gloom that has captured my heart.

@@U01729@@
And I'm like any old alley tomcat
out on the prowl, up the fire escape,
hugging close along the wall, always
looking, primed for the pounce.
And to be quite honest,
I feel rather virtuous about it, I do.
A touch of thievery,
a soupcon of lechery.
Every tingling limb
looks forward to 瓦尔普吉斯 Night.
The glory of it, two more days,
that’s when you learn what it means to be alive!
translation:
@@U01724@@
“差存一个儿子痛风！” |哭了，
举起我的酒杯。
“给我找个配我格蕾琴的女孩吧！
给我一个更好的妹妹！”
我们都碰杯了。
吹牛者坐在那里，就像木头上的凹凸一样。
但他们现在蔑视我，
嘲笑我，
给我起个名字吧！
我羞愧地坐在那里，接受这一切，
和我|不能说他们中的一个是骗子！
那是谁来了？
其中两个人，偷偷地朝她的门走去。
如果是这个混蛋，我就杀了他！
我要杀了他！

@@U01725@@
（浮士德和梅菲斯特上。）

@@U01727@@
我看到圣器收藏室里的圣所灯，
它的光芒向上射出，然后越来越暗，
渐渐消失，被黑暗和忧郁吞噬，
同样的忧郁抓住了我的心。

@@U01729@@
我就像老巷子里的雄猫
四处搜寻，爬上消防梯，
总是紧紧地靠着墙拥抱
寻找，准备突袭。
老实说，
我对此感到相当有道德，我确实如此。
有点偷窃的感觉，
好色汤
每一个四肢发麻
期待瓦尔普吉斯之夜。
光荣的事，还有两天，
那是你知道活着意味着什么的时候！
